card.name: Words just before tourists or visitors
card.fires_on: Small linking words or the start of a word right before an expected 'tourists', 'tourism' or 'visitors'. Seen in travel, heritage-site and destination text.

modes.label: Linking word before tourists
modes.description: A word like 'of', 'by' or 'for' where 'tourists' or 'visitors' is likely to come next.
modes.example: the attraction of millions<< of>> tourists.12 However

modes.label: Start of Tourist
modes.description: The first piece of the word Tourist or Tour, before 'ists' or 'ist'.
modes.example: outside the east gate of the palace.<< Tour>>ists can see architectural remains of all periods

modes.label: Modifier before visitors
modes.description: An adjective or similar word in a phrase about visitor numbers or travel.
modes.example: bring back more<< international>> visitors during summer.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward tourism words such as tourists, tourism and tour, mostly in Chinese and English.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to mention tourists or tourism.
